comment: Ordered rebrand rules for the openobserve-sdk-android-gradle-plugin fork (fork of DataDog/dd-sdk-android-gradle-plugin, base UPSTREAM_BASE). This is the ProGuard/NDK symbol-upload Gradle plugin (doc 06 #7). PHASE A = IDENTITY rebrand only: package namespace, plugin id, Datadog/DATADOG/DD_ identifiers, filenames. The FUNCTIONAL upload endpoint (DatadogSite host values, datadoghq.com intake URLs, auth) is intentionally NOT rewritten here — repointing to OpenObserve's /api/{org}/sourcemaps intake is an API-adapter patch (Phase B, patches/), not a string swap (see intentionallyNotRebranded). Reuses the Android fork's rebrand.mjs (pathRenames -> fileRenames -> content rules). Run to a fixpoint with --check.

pathRenames.why: slash-form Maven group in any resource/metadata path; MUST precede com/datadog (hq boundary means it won't be matched by com/datadog, but explicit-first keeps intent).
Kotlin/Java package namespace dir move for all com.datadog.* (gradle.plugin, gradle.plugin.kcp, kcp, android.compose/instrumented, example).

fileRenames.why: class-name files whose basename carries Datadog after the content rules rename the class inside (DatadogPluginRegistrar.kt, DatadogCiFileConfig.kt, DatadogSite.kt, ...).

rules.why: repo URLs (before the generic dd-sdk-android-gradle-plugin rule)
the PUBLISHED plugin id consumers apply (id("...")) + gradlePlugin block. Our own plugin, so renamed. MUST precede com.datadoghq.
Maven group id in publishing config
artifact id / module refs (after the repo-URL + plugin-id rules)
slash-form Maven group in content (before broad com/datadog)
slash-form package path in content (.api dumps, test strings, resource descriptors)
package + import declarations across all com.datadog.* (after com.datadoghq so the group is consumed first, never corrupted to com.openobservehq)
type/object names + mid-word compounds: DatadogSite, DatadogPluginRegistrar, DatadogCiFileConfig, DatadogModifierSymbol, getDatadogConfig. No leading \b so mid-identifier occurrences are caught.
catch-all for any remaining mixed-case Datadog substring. After the compound rule. Safe: no kept token contains 'Datadog' (attribution is in NOTICE/LICENSE, excluded).
SCREAMING_CASE constant names incl. mid-word (after '_'). Does not touch lowercase datadoghq.com wire/host values.
env-var NAME prefixes the plugin defines/reads (DD_API_KEY, DD_SITE, DD_TAGS, DD_AGENT_HOST). \b guards against mid-token (ADD_, ODD_). The VALUES/auth behavior are Phase B.
lowercase camelCase identifiers (datadogConfig, datadogSite). Word-boundary guarded so it never matches x-datadog-* or datadoghq host strings (followed by '-'/'h', not [A-Z]).
internal telemetry namespace field (matches the schema fork)

intentionallyNotRebranded.comment: PHASE B — functional intake adapter (patches/), NOT a string rename. Repointing the upload from Datadog's intake to OpenObserve's /api/{org}/sourcemaps changes URL construction, the multipart shape, and auth — real code, tested separately.
items: datadoghq.com / DatadogSite host VALUES (us1/eu1/... -> datadoghq.com): the upload host. Phase B replaces the site->host mapping with an OpenObserve endpoint config.
the Datadog sourcemap-intake API shape (event metadata + multipart): Phase B adapts it to OpenObserve's /sourcemaps multipart (service/env/version + file fields, doc 06 §2).
auth: Datadog uses DD_API_KEY against the intake; Phase B wires the OpenObserve org token (same header as ingest, doc 02 §1).
keep-ours identity files (README, LICENSE/NOTICE, .github) + CHANGELOG reset.
